source.prompt: Flat orthographic straight-on photograph of exactly 3 m x 3 m of a weathered precast concrete wall panel section, face-on, filling the entire frame edge to edge. Exactly one horizontal and one vertical sealed joint with old dark sealant crossing the frame. Muted desaturated grey Soviet industrial ruin, physically plausible colours, stains and grime. Even overcast diffuse daylight, no cast shadows, no directional light, no vignette, no lighting gradient, no perspective, no objects, no text, no watermark. Uniform exposure across the whole image.
